title: Change — Pipeline
description: Where every merge stands, keyed by commit SHA (ADR-0010): the live SHA per surface, the newest `main` commit per repo, what is in flight, the stage timeline, merge-to-live latency, and the pre-merge half per branch. Built from the GitHub Actions feed (log_source=github_actions_run|github_actions_job, lentago/betula#113) and the `live` emitters ({pipeline="change", stage="live"}). The joins between those streams are Grafana transforms; the one LogQL vector match is the apply job to run hop (ADR-0010 v1 rule), which needs the run's head_sha as a label.

list.name: repo
list.label: Repo
list.description: Repos seen in the GitHub Actions feed.

panels.title: Live now
panels.description: The latest change-pipeline `live` event per repo and surface over the last 7 days: the commit each surface runs, the tick's result and when it was emitted. Keyed only on pipeline="change", stage="live" (ADR-0010), so a new `<source>_live` emitter appears here without a dashboard edit. Emitters report every tick, no-ops included, so an age past ~10 minutes means the surface stopped reporting. Terraform surfaces have no emitter; panel "In flight" counts their apply job as live (ADR-0010 v1 rule). The apply-as-live rule applies only to the terraform repos ADR-0010 lists (.github, kalmia, claytonia, drosera, betula, solidago); their surface reads terraform:<repo>.

targets.expr: topk by (repo, surface) (1, max by (repo, surface, sha, result) (max_over_time({pipeline="change", stage="live", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo"} | json sha="sha", surface="surface", result="result", applied_at="applied_at" | label_format live_ts=`{{ toDate "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00" .applied_at | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap live_ts | __error__="" [$__range]))) * 1000

panels.title: Newest main commit per repo
panels.description: The newest merge commit on `main` per repo over the last 7 days, from `github_actions_run` events with event="push" and branch="main": its head_sha and when it merged (the earliest push run's created_at for that SHA). Caveat (ADR-0010): repos whose push workflows are path-filtered are missing merges that trigger no push workflow, such as docs-only merges in drosera (terraform.yml and status-page.yml both path-filter), so the newest commit here can trail the real `main` head.

targets.expr: topk by (repo) (1, min by (repo, head_sha) (min_over_time({log_source="github_actions_run", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo"} | json event="event", branch="branch", head_sha="head_sha", created_at="created_at" | event="push" | branch="main" | label_format merged_ts=`{{ toDate "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00" .created_at | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap merged_ts | __error__="" [$__range]))) * 1000

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Repos with a live source (a `live` emitter, or a terraform apply on merge: .github, kalmia, claytonia, drosera, betula, solidago) whose newest `main` commit has no `live` event carrying that SHA in the last 7 days. Live means a `live` event from any surface of the repo, or a `github_actions_job` whose name is `apply` or `Terraform Apply` (case-insensitive, with or without a reusable-workflow prefix) with conclusion=success, matched to its run on (repo, run_id, run_attempt) for the head_sha (ADR-0010 v1 rule). Repos without a live source (sites until their version probe lands, the uvularia template and demo repos) are left out rather than shown red forever. budget used = time since merge ÷ the propagation budget (10 min; 20 min for site-* repos): amber past 100%, red past 200%. An empty table means nothing is in flight only while "Live now" and "Newest main commit per repo" have data.

targets.expr: label_replace(topk by (repo) (1, min by (repo, sha) (min_over_time({log_source="github_actions_run", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo", repo=~"lentago/(\.github|kalmia|claytonia|drosera|betula|solidago)"} | json event="event", branch="branch", sha="head_sha", created_at="created_at" | event="push" | branch="main" | label_format merged_ts=`{{ toDate "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00" .created_at | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap merged_ts | __error__="" [$__range]))), "kind", "merged", "", "") * 1000

(${__to} / 1000 - label_replace(topk by (repo) (1, min by (repo, sha) (min_over_time({log_source="github_actions_run", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo", repo=~"lentago/(\.github|kalmia|claytonia|drosera|betula|solidago)", repo!~"lentago/site-.+"} | json event="event", branch="branch", sha="head_sha", created_at="created_at" | event="push" | branch="main" | label_format merged_ts=`{{ toDate "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00" .created_at | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap merged_ts | __error__="" [$__range]))), "kind", "budget_used", "", "")) / 600 or (${__to} / 1000 - label_replace(topk by (repo) (1, min by (repo, sha) (min_over_time({log_source="github_actions_run", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo", repo=~"lentago/(\.github|kalmia|claytonia|drosera|betula|solidago)", repo=~"lentago/site-.+"} | json event="event", branch="branch", sha="head_sha", created_at="created_at" | event="push" | branch="main" | label_format merged_ts=`{{ toDate "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00" .created_at | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap merged_ts | __error__="" [$__range]))), "kind", "budget_used", "", "")) / 1200

label_replace(min by (repo, sha) (min_over_time({pipeline="change", stage="live", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo"} | json sha="sha", surface="surface", applied_at="applied_at" | label_format live_ts=`{{ toDate "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00" .applied_at | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap live_ts | __error__="" [$__range])) or min by (repo, sha) (min by (repo, run_id, run_attempt) (min_over_time({log_source="github_actions_job", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo", repo=~"lentago/(\.github|kalmia|claytonia|drosera|betula|solidago)"} | json run_id="run_id", run_attempt="run_attempt", job_name="job_name", conclusion="conclusion", completed_at="completed_at" | conclusion="success" | job_name=~"(?i)(.* / )?(terraform )?apply" | label_format applied_ts=`{{ toDate "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00" .completed_at | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap applied_ts | __error__="" [$__range])) + on (repo, run_id, run_attempt) group_left (sha) (0 * max by (repo, run_id, run_attempt, sha) (count_over_time({log_source="github_actions_run", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo"} | json run_id="run_id", run_attempt="run_attempt", sha="head_sha" [$__range])))) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "repo", "-", "", ""), "sha", "-", "", ""), "kind", "live", "", "") * 1000

panels.title: Stage timeline
panels.description: One row per repo over the dashboard range, showing the furthest stage reached in each interval (the query ORs the three stages with live first, so a later stage takes precedence): merged (a push-to-main run completed), applied (an `apply` job succeeded) or live (a `live` event with result="applied", i.e. a surface took a new SHA; no-op ticks are left out). Discrete events, not durations: each state holds until the next event. For the terraform surfaces "applied" is also their live (ADR-0010 v1 rule). The live row keys only on pipeline="change", stage="live", so a new emitter appears without an edit. The apply-as-live rule applies only to the terraform repos ADR-0010 lists (.github, kalmia, claytonia, drosera, betula, solidago); their surface reads terraform:<repo>.

targets.expr: (sum by (repo) (count_over_time({pipeline="change", stage="live", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo"} | json result="result" | result="applied" [$__interval])) > 0) * 0 + 3 or (sum by (repo) (count_over_time({log_source="github_actions_job", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo", repo=~"lentago/(\.github|kalmia|claytonia|drosera|betula|solidago)"} | json job_name="job_name", conclusion="conclusion" | conclusion="success" | job_name=~"(?i)(.* / )?(terraform )?apply" [$__interval])) > 0) * 0 + 2 or (sum by (repo) (count_over_time({log_source="github_actions_run", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo"} | json event="event", branch="branch" | event="push" | branch="main" [$__interval])) > 0) * 0 + 1

panels.title: Merge to live
panels.description: Each merge to `main` in the dashboard range (first push-to-main run per SHA; its created_at is the merge time) joined on sha to the first `live` event carrying the same SHA, per surface. Terraform surfaces use the ADR-0010 v1 rule (apply job success, surface "terraform"). The join is Grafana's Merge transform on the shared sha column, kept only where both sides are present, so merges with no live event yet are left out (see "In flight"). Merges missing from the push feed (path-filtered repos) cannot be joined. The apply-as-live rule applies only to the terraform repos ADR-0010 lists (.github, kalmia, claytonia, drosera, betula, solidago); their surface reads terraform:<repo>.

targets.expr: label_replace(min by (sha) (min_over_time({log_source="github_actions_run", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo"} | json event="event", branch="branch", sha="head_sha", created_at="created_at" | event="push" | branch="main" | label_format merged_ts=`{{ toDate "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00" .created_at | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap merged_ts | __error__="" [$__range])), "kind", "merged", "", "") * 1000

label_replace(min by (repo, sha, surface) (min_over_time({pipeline="change", stage="live", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo"} | json sha="sha", surface="surface", applied_at="applied_at" | label_format live_ts=`{{ toDate "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00" .applied_at | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap live_ts | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(min by (repo, sha) (min by (repo, run_id, run_attempt) (min_over_time({log_source="github_actions_job", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo", repo=~"lentago/(\.github|kalmia|claytonia|drosera|betula|solidago)"} | json run_id="run_id", run_attempt="run_attempt", job_name="job_name", conclusion="conclusion", completed_at="completed_at" | conclusion="success" | job_name=~"(?i)(.* / )?(terraform )?apply" | label_format applied_ts=`{{ toDate "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00" .completed_at | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap applied_ts | __error__="" [$__range])) + on (repo, run_id, run_attempt) group_left (sha) (0 * max by (repo, run_id, run_attempt, sha) (count_over_time({log_source="github_actions_run", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo"} | json run_id="run_id", run_attempt="run_attempt", sha="head_sha" [$__range])))), "surface", "terraform:$1", "repo", "lentago/(.+)"), "kind", "live", "", "") * 1000

panels.title: Merge to live — latency per surface
panels.description: Each merge to `main` in the dashboard range (first push-to-main run per SHA; its created_at is the merge time) joined on sha to the first `live` event carrying the same SHA, per surface. Terraform surfaces use the ADR-0010 v1 rule (apply job success, surface "terraform"). The join is Grafana's Merge transform on the shared sha column, kept only where both sides are present, so merges with no live event yet are left out (see "In flight"). Merges missing from the push feed (path-filtered repos) cannot be joined. One point per merge, at its merge time; one series per surface. The apply-as-live rule applies only to the terraform repos ADR-0010 lists (.github, kalmia, claytonia, drosera, betula, solidago); their surface reads terraform:<repo>.

targets.expr: label_replace(min by (sha) (min_over_time({log_source="github_actions_run", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo"} | json event="event", branch="branch", sha="head_sha", created_at="created_at" | event="push" | branch="main" | label_format merged_ts=`{{ toDate "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00" .created_at | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap merged_ts | __error__="" [$__range])), "kind", "merged", "", "") * 1000

label_replace(min by (repo, sha, surface) (min_over_time({pipeline="change", stage="live", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo"} | json sha="sha", surface="surface", applied_at="applied_at" | label_format live_ts=`{{ toDate "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00" .applied_at | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap live_ts | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(min by (repo, sha) (min by (repo, run_id, run_attempt) (min_over_time({log_source="github_actions_job", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo", repo=~"lentago/(\.github|kalmia|claytonia|drosera|betula|solidago)"} | json run_id="run_id", run_attempt="run_attempt", job_name="job_name", conclusion="conclusion", completed_at="completed_at" | conclusion="success" | job_name=~"(?i)(.* / )?(terraform )?apply" | label_format applied_ts=`{{ toDate "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00" .completed_at | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap applied_ts | __error__="" [$__range])) + on (repo, run_id, run_attempt) group_left (sha) (0 * max by (repo, run_id, run_attempt, sha) (count_over_time({log_source="github_actions_run", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo"} | json run_id="run_id", run_attempt="run_attempt", sha="head_sha" [$__range])))), "surface", "terraform:$1", "repo", "lentago/(.+)"), "kind", "live", "", "") * 1000

panels.title: Pre-merge half, by branch
panels.description: The latest `pull_request` run per repo and branch over the last 7 days: its head_sha, workflow, conclusion and completion time. This half is keyed by the PR head SHA, which differs from the merge commit SHA because the fleet squash-merges (ADR-0010), so these rows do not join to the panels above until the feed carries the PR number (lentago/betula#133). Only completed runs are in the feed, so a branch appears once its first PR workflow finishes.

targets.expr: topk by (repo, branch) (1, max by (repo, branch, head_sha, workflow, conclusion) (max_over_time({log_source="github_actions_run", cluster="lentago", repo=~"$repo"} | json event="event", branch="branch", head_sha="head_sha", workflow="workflow", conclusion="conclusion", updated_at="updated_at" | event="pull_request" | branch!="main" | label_format updated_ts=`{{ toDate "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00" .updated_at | unixEpoch }}` | unwrap updated_ts | __error__="" [$__range]))) * 1000
